parts.part_stem:
Nuclei X and Y are different isotopes of the same element.

Nucleus X is unstable and emits a $\beta^{+}$ particle to form nucleus Z.

By comparing the number of protons in each nucleus, state and explain whether the charge of nucleus X is less than, the same as or greater than the charge of:

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: Hadrons can be divided into two groups (classes), P and Q. Group P is baryons.
parts.text: State the name of group Q.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Describe, in general terms, the quark structure of hadrons that belong to group Q.
